headline: Ouattara rescues point for Brentford as Hull maintain unbeaten home record
body: Hull’s unbeaten home record remains intact but the Tigers have not tasted victory for seven games after this draw with Brentford. The opening goal came courtesy of a 24th-minute Oli McBurnie penalty, awarded when Aaron Hickey flattened Tim Iroegbunam while trying to hook the ball away. Continue reading...
